target.statement: HVISNet achieves sMOTSA of 52.1 on the HVIS validation set

compute.basis: Training HVISNet for 12 epochs on the HVIS dataset (805 videos) requires a GPU; the paper used an RTX 2080 Ti (11GB VRAM). On a CPU-only laptop, training would be impractically slow (estimated >12 hours), and even inference on the validation set would take hours. The code and data are linked but may not be fully available or up-to-date.

blockers: Training requires a GPU (paper used RTX 2080 Ti)

Code repository may be incomplete or outdated
